hook.name: QuantisFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a volatility-adaptive ETH fee (1–5%) on every swap in ETH/token pools. Buy fees are taken from the ETH input in beforeSwap; sell fees from the ETH output in afterSwap. The fee scales between a configurable base and max based on tick movement from the previous swap. Only exact-input swaps are allowed; exact-output swaps revert.
